business_problem: Kohl’s needed to make governed enterprise data easier to use across the business and also wanted customer-facing shopping assistants that could guide discovery without forcing teams to build separate AI stacks for each use case.
solution_summary: Kohl's uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Kohl’s needed to make governed enterprise data easier to use across the business and also wanted customer-facing shopping assistants that could guide discovery without forcing teams to build separate AI stacks for each use case. Gemini acts as the front door to AI for internal agents and customer-facing shopping experiences, serving as the serving layer. Gemini platform hosts custom agents that turn analysis into active conversation and support guided gifting experiences, serving as the serving layer. Looker provides the trusted semantic layer that grounds agent responses in business logic and governed metrics, serving as the serving layer. BigQuery stores the governed data foundation that the agents query conversationally, serving as the storage layer.

evidence_quotes: For more than 60 years, leading omnichannel retailer

has been serving and celebrating families of all kinds, taking care of them through all the realest moments of everyday life. In today’s fast-moving retail landscape, delivering on that promise means making the right decisions while moving at the speed of the customer — no small task given Kohl’s operates over 1,100 physical stores across the United States and supports millions of shoppers online.
Using the Gemini platform, Kohl’s built a custom agent that turns analysis into an active conversation accessible to anyone.
Using Looker’s trusted semantic layer on top of its data foundation in BigQuery, Kohl’s can define the structure of its data and business logic.
We’re using Gemini for customer experience to build an AI-powered gifting agent.
data_flow: Enterprise data is modeled in Looker on top of BigQuery, Gemini agents translate natural-language questions into governed insights for associates, and the same agentic foundation powers customer gifting guidance and multimodal product discovery.
